frontmatter.title: Ontology Atlas
frontmatter.description: A local-first codebase ontology workbench that records what a codebase builds, why it is structured that way, and what a change will affect, linking product meaning to implementation evidence in Markdown that people and AI agents maintain together.

relation_notes.domains/agent-integration: Atlas promises that an AI agent reads and maintains the same vault a person does, so the project keeps agent transport, MCP, the terminal CLI, the in-app connect flow, and the ACP executor, as one stable boundary, separate from the schema those agents write.
relation_notes.domains/codebase-architecture: The project needs somewhere to declare reviewed implementation roles and dependency rules and compare them against observed source imports; that stays separate from the ontology map, which records what the product means rather than how the code is organised.
relation_notes.domains/design-system: People and agents build screens from the same predefined values, so the project holds the source of those values and the gates that fail on deviation as one boundary, owning values only up to their source and not the map's rendering.
relation_notes.domains/graph-modeling: Markdown frontmatter is the project's whole database, so the authorable kinds, the relation vocabulary, the non-inference boundaries, and the check that the compiled graph still tells the truth are kept apart from the business meaning any single domain carries.
relation_notes.domains/local-vault-management: The project promises backend-zero, local-first data, so choosing a folder on disk, branching between a picked vault and a sample source, and treating Git as the source of truth form their own boundary, separate from the graph-editing surface.
relation_notes.domains/onboarding-and-shell: The project has to carry someone from a shared link to an installed, connected app in the first five minutes, so the download decision, first run, locale, auto-update, and the navigation shell around them stay one boundary, separate from the vault data source itself.
relation_notes.domains/project-portfolio: One vault can hold several project nodes, so listing, viewing, editing, and sharing them is its own responsibility, distinct from the meaning of the domains and capabilities those projects contain.
relation_notes.domains/topology-navigation: The canvas map is the product's primary entry point for reading the whole vault visually, so browsing, renderer, search palette, index panel, is kept apart from graph editing.
